stem.text: A steel wire has a length of $300\,\text{cm}$ and a cross-sectional area of $0.50\,\text{mm}^{2}$. The Young modulus of steel is $2.0 \times 10^{11}\,\text{Pa}$.
One end of the wire is attached to a fixed point. A load of $10\,\text{N}$ is hung from the other end. The wire obeys Hooke's law.
What is the extension of the wire?
